request: Order ORD-1012 still hasn't shipped and the customer is asking. What went wrong and what should we do?

steps.text: I will check the order details to confirm its status, promised delivery date, items, and fulfillment warehouse to determine why it hasn't shipped.
I will check inventory for SKU-101 at WH-CHI to see if a stock shortage is preventing shipment.
I will look for alternative stock for SKU-101 to cover the shortfall of 10 units from other warehouses so we can fulfill the order.

arguments.summary: The order missed its promised date and has not shipped because WH-CHI does not have enough stock of SKU-101 to fulfill the 30-unit order. There is a 10-unit shortfall at the fulfillment warehouse.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1012 for Tailwind Traders at WH-CHI, fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT, promised_delivery_date 2026-03-15, ship_by_date 2026-03-12, items SKU-101 qty 30, is_past_promised_date true (days_until_promised_date -1).
check_inventory: SKU-101 at WH-CHI on_hand 20, reserved 0, available 20 (ordered 30) — shortfall 10.
find_alternative_stock: For SKU-101 required_quantity 10, WH-BOS available 35 can_cover_required_quantity true; WH-DAL available 15 can_cover_required_quantity true; WH-ATL available 0 cannot cover.
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient available inventory at WH-CHI (20 available vs 30 ordered) prevented shipment by the ship-by date.
uncertainties: Transfer lead time from the source warehouse to WH-CHI is not known from available data.
Customer preference on partial shipment versus waiting for a consolidated shipment is unknown.

recommended_actions.details: Initiate an inter-warehouse transfer of 10 units of SKU-101 from WH-BOS to WH-CHI to cover the shortfall; justified by check_inventory: WH-CHI available 20 vs ordered 30 (shortfall 10) and find_alternative_stock: WH-BOS available 35 and can_cover_required_quantity true.
Release and ship 20 units of SKU-101 from WH-CHI now, and ship the remaining 10 units upon receipt of the transfer; justified by check_inventory: available 20 at WH-CHI vs ordered 30.

Inform Tailwind Traders that the order is delayed due to a 10-unit stock shortfall at WH-CHI (check_inventory), outline the plan to ship 20 now with 10 to follow after a transfer from WH-BOS (find_alternative_stock), and provide an updated ETA once transfer timing is confirmed.

arguments.recommendation: Transfer 10 units of SKU-101 from WH-BOS to WH-CHI and ship the 20 available units now; notify the customer about the delay and the two-step fulfillment plan.
